answer: This economy prices every new agent identity with a stake locked for many epochs and slashed on fraud, so a Sybil farm must post that capital per clone. Attacker cost scales linearly while the reward for a fake vote stays flat, which kills the profit margin. Like a river, reward flows only down a fixed channel bed, so widening it needs real excavation. Validators see the capital pulse before voting weight appears, and penalties stack like shale layers, so fraud loses deposits at every layer.
